newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's banks switch to summer hours.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's banks switch to summer hours.

text.p: Morocco's banks, including Bank al-Maghrib (state central bank), on Monday went into summer working hours of 8 am (0800 GMT) to 2 pm (1400 GMT), a Moroccan official said.
The new opening hours were effective from June 15 to September 15, 1997, the official said.
The Casablanca-based stock exchange also switched to the new timing, he added.
Bank's working hours were from 0800 to 1200 GMT and from 1430 to 1830 GMT during the winter-spring seasons.
